full_details: The sleet had blown through. The morning was hard and bright. At the Theatre, Heminges held a muster and saw both heels. New hose for the whole company came out of the stock at twenty-six shillings. Kemp presented his feet. Pope held up an old pair with a heel a fist could go through, and he was satisfied about Greenwich. Garnish put three books and sixty rolls in a chest and sat on it. Bryan gave the order of going. Sharers, then hired men, then boys. Nobody is to speak to a yeoman of the guard first, and nobody is to touch a hanging. Sam asked whether the Queen is truly there or whether it is the chair again. The court went up to Richmond this morning. Nick was in the room. He has not sung for four days, by Phillips's order, and Phillips was not there to repeat it. There was no play after. At home you wrote a list. The second shirt goes. The grey cloak goes. The chronicle stays. The pages of the wood stay, and you did not count them. You told Mistress Ansell you go at first light. You did not count the coffer.
one_sentence: You showed both heels, saw twenty-six shillings go out in new hose, and packed a second shirt.
title: Showed both heels and packed a second shirt
